# @mongez/cache

> 标签: async-cache, browser, browser-cache, cache, cache-manager, encrypted-session-storage, encryption-local-storage, expiration, indexeddb, key-prefix, local-storage, memory-cache, persist-adapter, runtime-cache, session-storage, storage, ttl

## 简介

Framework-agnostic async cache facade with pluggable drivers — localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, runtime memory, plus encrypted variants. One API, key prefixing, TTL, and a PersistAdapter-compatible shape for @mongez/atom.
